days.title: Coastal Quarries and Coves
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Es Cap des Moro
stops.detail: Evidence of this activity are the old quarries that we see in Es Cap des Moro and s'Estret des Temps.

stops.name: Mondragó
stops.detail: All this results in the formation of torrential valleys or long and narrow ravines, the mouths of which are invaded by the sea, thus creating coves like that of Mondragón.

days.title: Wetlands and Sandy Shores
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Ses Fonts de n'Alis
stops.detail: The vegetation that we find in the Ses Fonts de n'Alis pond is typical of brackish environments where salt imposes its conditions.

stops.name: s'Amarador
stops.detail: In the s'Amarador pond we find a vegetation more typical of less saline environments, in which reed (Phragmites australis) stands out.

stops.name: Playa de s'Amarador
stops.detail: We will find it mainly at the s'Amarador beach, where some plants typical of sandy environments can be seen.

stops.name: Caló den Garrot
stops.detail: At the Caló den Garrot beach, this vegetation is very degraded due to the excess of wheeled traffic associated with tourist facilities.
